title_or_subject: Proclamation offering amnesty to soldiers absent without leave (Proclamation respecting soldiers absent without leave)

sources.what: Ohio Civil War Central transcription of the proclamation
sources.quote: On March 10, 1863, U.S. President Abraham Lincoln issued a proclamation offering amnesty to soldiers absent without leave

queries_tried: Lincoln order March 10, 1863 unnumbered web search
dheller.org Statutes at Large v12 proc17-p1268 (is the Jan 1 1863 proclamation, not this)
notes: This is the only Lincoln document dated March 10, 1863 that the search surfaced. It is a proclamation (the page says the transcribed text is dated 'Executive Mansion, March 10, 1863' and closes 'Done at the city of Washington, this tenth day of March'). I could not confirm that the Lord 1944 unnumbered entry (EO:UNN:LORD1944:p1:1863-03-10) is this document or some other order of that date; the project should compare with the Lord entry text. No official printing (12 Stat. 1269 area) was opened.
